avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces zolpidem levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative antidepressant if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; separate dosing by 12+ hours if necessary

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for excessive sedation

caution_supplements.name: Chamomile
caution_supplements.action: Monitor patient response; adjust dosing if needed

caution_supplements.name: Melatonin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive effects on sleep onset and duration
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive sedation; may allow zolpidem dose reduction

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Delays zolpidem absorption and onset of action
avoid_foods.action: Take on empty stomach; avoid fatty foods within 2 hours of dosing

avoid_foods.name: Alcohol
avoid_foods.mechanism: Severe additive CNS depression, respiratory depression, and overdose risk
avoid_foods.action: Absolute contraindication; counsel patient to avoid all alcohol

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase zolpidem levels
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; monitor for excessive sedation if intake cannot be avoided

monitoring_notes: Monitor for excessive sedation, complex sleep behaviors, and respiratory depression, especially in elderly patients or those with hepatic impairment. Advise patients to take zolpidem on an empty stomach immediately before bed for optimal efficacy.
